name: omnisense/omnicrawl
description: Omnicrawl: fetch and extract web pages under any PHP host, through crawling services or directly, responsible by default - the target site's rules applied by the family itself before any service is called. robots.txt read and honoured per RFC 9309 for the family's own token, a usage policy per target site declared as data (allowed or refused, on what authority, with a reference and a date, its rate limits, what may be stored and republished) and a conservative default for the others (single pages for previews, no crawl run), an identified User-Agent required by every factory, per-host limits through omnisense/contracts' PolicyGuard beside the provider's own, X-Robots-Tag, meta robots and TDMRep reservations honoured, provenance on every record. Three contracts: page-fetch, extract (metadata, Open Graph, JSON-LD, selectors), crawl-runs. A direct fetcher built in; omnicrawl/apify, omnicrawl/firecrawl, omnicrawl/scrapingbee, omnicrawl/zyte as packages of their own, none of their evasion features exposed.

suggest.symfony/http-client: The HTTP client the gate reads robots.txt with and the direct provider fetches with (any HttpClientInterface does)
suggest.omnicrawl/firecrawl: Firecrawl (v2): pages fetched, rendered or not, and batch runs over a set of addresses
suggest.omnicrawl/scrapingbee: ScrapingBee: pages fetched, rendered or not, the target's headers reported, for targets declared under a licence only (its rotating proxies hide who collects)
suggest.omnicrawl/zyte: Zyte API: pages fetched over HTTP, for targets declared under a licence only (its ban avoidance cannot be turned off)
suggest.omnicrawl/apify: Apify: runs over a set of addresses with the Cheerio Scraper actor, raw HTML and headers kept
suggest.omnisense/omnibridge: The host contracts; omnibridge/symfony and omnibridge/laravel give a shared limiter and store
